title: Interfaces Ethernet DHCP/DHCPv6/IPv6 parity depth pass (IF-15 subset)
acceptance_criteria: Ethernet GUI supports DHCP options reject routes and user-class with deterministic set/delete semantics.
Ethernet GUI supports DHCPv6 options no-release, parameters-only, and temporary flags with robust toggle handling.
Ethernet GUI supports IPv6 accept-dad and no-default-link-local options plus correct autoconf/eui64 round-trip behavior.
Backend router/builder/mapper support all newly exposed ethernet operations and preserve legacy set_* value=false compatibility via delete mapping.
Validation gates pass: backend targeted pytest, frontend tsc, targeted eslint, build, runtime smoke, UI smoke.
assumptions: IF-15 remains partial after this slice because loopback and wireguard option-depth work is still pending.
This slice intentionally extends existing ethernet endpoints/contracts rather than introducing new interface APIs.

tasks.notes: Added mapper paths, builder methods, response model fields, capabilities entries, and batch operation handlers for new DHCP/DHCPv6/IPv6 leaves and delete semantics.
Added Ethernet modal controls and operation generation for reject/user-class/no-release/parameters-only/temporary/accept-dad/no-default-link-local; fixed autoconf/eui64 diff logic.
Added router regression coverage for new ops and legacy false->delete behavior; full validation gates passed.
Execute next IF-15 depth slices for loopback and wireguard in guide order.
